entry.title: sfizz 1.1.1
entry.summary: ## 1.1.1 — fix: freeze in the SFZ browser This release fixes a freeze that could occur when browsing SFZ files in the SFZ browser on MPC OS devices. ### Changes - Fix freeze in SFZ browser navigation - Updated vst.json version to 1101

entry.title: sfizz 1.1.0
entry.summary: The [sfizz](https://github.com/sfztools/sfizz) 1.2.3 SFZ sampler as a native instrument plugin for MPC OS standalone hardware: SFZ libraries streamed from SD cards and USB drives, key switches, the instrument's own CC controls and Scala tuning, on a one-page screen modelled on sfizz's own editor. ## Download the zip for your device | Device | Zip | |---|---| | **Gen1**: MPC Live / Live II, One, X, Key 61, Force (RK3288, 32-bit) | `sfizz-1.1.0-mpc-armv7.zip` | | **Gen2**: MPC Live III and other R
